### Laporan Perubahan

Perubahan UI telah diimplementasikan sesuai seluruh acceptance criteria pada task:

1. **[ObjectiveVisualEvidencePanel.tsx](file:///Users/sagaino/Documents/personal-ai-orchestrator/runs/workspaces/orchestrator-dashboard/task-038-20260824t185711z-3cb60809/src/pages/Objectives/components/ObjectiveVisualEvidencePanel.tsx)**:

2. **[DeliveryCertificationPanel.tsx](file:///Users/sagaino/Documents/personal-ai-orchestrator/runs/workspaces/orchestrator-dashboard/task-038-20260824t185711z-3cb60809/src/pages/Objectives/components/DeliveryCertificationPanel.tsx)**:

   - State `nodesOpen` diatur independen dengan nilai awal `false` (tertutup secara default).

4. **[objectives.ts](file:///Users/sagaino/Documents/personal-ai-orchestrator/runs/workspaces/orchestrator-dashboard/task-038-20260824t185711z-3cb60809/src/pages/Objectives/types/objectives.ts)**:
